sql: WITH RECURSIVE bounds AS (SELECT customer_id,MIN(txn_date) first_d,MAX(txn_date) last_d FROM customer_transactions GROUP BY customer_id), spine(customer_id,d,first_d,last_d) AS (SELECT customer_id,first_d,first_d,last_d FROM bounds UNION ALL SELECT customer_id,date(d,'+1 day'),first_d,last_d FROM spine WHERE d<last_d), rawrows AS (SELECT s.*,COALESCE(t.rowid,0) transaction_row,COALESCE(CASE WHEN t.txn_type='deposit' THEN t.txn_amount ELSE -t.txn_amount END,0) amount FROM spine s LEFT JOIN customer_transactions t ON s.customer_id=t.customer_id AND s.d=t.txn_date), balances AS (SELECT *,SUM(amount) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY d RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) day_closing,SUM(amount) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY d,transaction_row ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) transaction_closing FROM rawrows), kinds AS (SELECT 'daily_range' kind,*,day_closing balance FROM balances UNION ALL SELECT 'transaction_rows',*,transaction_closing FROM balances), roll AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY kind,customer_id ORDER BY d,transaction_row) rn,AVG(balance) OVER(PARTITION BY kind,customer_id ORDER BY d,transaction_row ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) avg30,AVG(balance) OVER(PARTITION BY kind,customer_id ORDER BY d,transaction_row ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) avg31 FROM kinds), variants AS (SELECT kind,customer_id,d,first_d,'30_at30' win,avg30 avg_balance FROM roll WHERE rn>=30 UNION ALL SELECT kind,customer_id,d,first_d,'31_at30',avg31 FROM roll WHERE rn>=30 UNION ALL SELECT kind,customer_id,d,first_d,'31_at31',avg31 FROM roll WHERE rn>=31), cm AS (SELECT kind,win,customer_id,date(d,'start of month') m,MAX(MAX(avg_balance,0)) mx FROM variants WHERE date(d,'start of month')>date(first_d,'start of month') GROUP BY kind,win,customer_id,m) SELECT kind,win,m,COUNT(*) customers,SUM(mx) total FROM cm GROUP BY kind,win,m ORDER BY kind,win,m
